messages:
Maria (Support): FYI customer AcmeCorp hit a chargeback on last invoice, payment reversed by bank and their account went negative after we clawed promo credits. They're seeing 402 Payment Required on our API and asking for an urgent fix.
Dan (Billing): Can you paste the chargeback ID and the invoice id? I'll pull the ledger.
Maria (Support): Chargeback id chb_1Hj2kL, invoice inv_2025_0421_993, user acct acme-prod-01. They report: "requests failing after refund".
Maria (Support): Quick repro from customer: POST /v1/generate with key X (redacted) => 402 {
  "error": "payment_required",
  "message": "negative balance: -$45.00; credits reclaimed"
}
Kevin (Eng): That matches a recent clawback flow where we automatically reclaimed promotional credits when a refund/chargeback hits. It then blocks token usage. Looks like clawback ran before we created a pending adjustment for the chargeback.
Olga (CSM): Customer is P0 about app outage. They expect a temporary credit while we sort the dispute. Can we grant emergency credits? :pray:
Dan (Billing): I can issue a manual grant of 50 USD in account-level credits (temp) but need approval from finance for permanent ledger correction. Granting now will unblock them.
stripe-bot: auto-notice: Chargeback chb_1Hj2kL recorded on 2025-07-09 14:22 UTC for amount 45.00 USD, reason: product_not_received.
Maria (Support): Thanks, Dan — please post the grant id once done so I can update AcmeCorp. Also need steps for reversing clawback if the chargeback later gets disputed in favor of us.
Dan (Billing): Manual grant issued: grant_2025_07_09_01 for $50. Customer unlocked. I'll open a finance ticket to reconcile: ticket FIN-8123.
Kevin (Eng): For engineering: root cause appears to be ordering in the billing worker: we run clawback job immediately on chargeback webhook and it marks promo credits as reclaimed before the payment dispute outcome is set. We should change flow to mark credits as "pending reclaim" and keep API allowance until final settlement or move to soft-block that returns a clear error. Repro steps I used: 
```
# replicate locally
POST /internal/test-chargeback {"account":"acme-prod-01","amount":45}
# run clawback worker
python -m app.billing.clawback_worker --dryrun=false
# call public API with same key => 402 payment_required
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -d '{"model":"rwd-small","prompt":"hi"}'
```
Kevin (Eng): I recommend a short-term patch: when clawback job sees a chargeback webhook, set account state to "under_review" and allow a grace credit buffer (configurable) to avoid hard failures, then finalize when webhook indicates 'chargeback: refunded' or 'chargeback: reversed'.
Dan (Billing): Agreed. I'll add the finance reconciliation step: if Stripe marks dispute lost (we owe), we keep clawback; if dispute won, we reverse reclaimed credits and update ledger.
Olga (CSM): I'll message AcmeCorp that we've issued a temporary $50 credit (grant_2025_07_09_01) to restore service and we're investigating. They asked for ETA on permanent fix.
Maria (Support): Next actions: 1) Dan -> finance ticket FIN-8123 for ledger correction and decision timeline. 2) Kevin -> patch clawback worker to pending state and add grace buffer. 3) Olga -> confirm customer acceptance. I'll follow up in 24h.
Dan (Billing): FIN-8123 created, asking finance for response within 48h. Adding notes and Stripe evidence.
Kevin (Eng): I'll open ENG-1542 with a small migration to introduce pending reclaim flag. ETA 3 days for patch + 1 day for testing.
Maria (Support): Great, thanks team. AcmeCorp is back online. Keeping this thread open until finance closes FIN-8123. :white_check_mark:
